result.instructions: Tools for Bill.pt, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the last 10 invoices for contact 42, newest first."; "Which VAT rates and document types does my Bill.pt account use?"; "Create a new customer with the NIF 500000000 and the email address billing@example.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bill.pt data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run billpt_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run billpt_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run billpt_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. billpt_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: billpt_list_document_types
tools.title: List document types
tools.description: List document types (invoice FT, simplified invoice FS, credit note NC and others) with their ids. Bill.pt API: GET /api/1.0/tipos-documento. Use the ids in other tools.

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use last_page in the response to read further pages.

tools.name: billpt_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List customers and suppliers (contacts) with their tax numbers, addresses and payment terms. Bill.pt API: GET /api/1.0/contatos.

name.description: Part of the contact name to match (case-insensitive).

code.description: Part of the contact code to match (case-insensitive).

tax_number.description: Part of the tax number (NIF) to match (case-insensitive).

email.description: Exact email address of the contact.

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use last_page in the response to read further pages.

tools.name: billpt_create_contact
tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Create a customer or supplier (contact) in the Bill.pt account. Bill.pt API: POST /api/1.0/contatos. The code must be unique in the account. The record is saved at once.

name.description: Contact name, max 30 characters. Use 'Consumidor Final' when unknown.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example PT (default PT).

code.description: Your own contact code, unique in the account, max 30 characters.

tools.name: billpt_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List products and services (items) with their codes, prices, tax rate and stock flag. Bill.pt API: GET /api/1.0/items.

description.description: Part of the item description to match (case-insensitive).

code.description: Part of the item code to match (case-insensitive).

barcode.description: Part of the barcode to match (case-insensitive).

service.description: true = services only, false = products only.

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use last_page in the response to read further pages.

tools.name: billpt_list_stock
tools.title: List stock
tools.description: Read stock levels per item and store at a date (default now). Bill.pt API: GET /api/1.0/stock.

date.description: Stock date and time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'. Default: now (Portugal time).

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use last_page in the response to read further pages.

tools.name: billpt_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List invoices, receipts and other sales documents, filtered by type, contact or number. Bill.pt API: GET /api/1.0/documentos. Read-only: this tool never creates or changes a document.

invoice_number.description: Part of the document number, for example 'FT B2016/1' to match (case-insensitive).

order_by.description: Field to sort by (default: the API order).

order_direction.description: Sort direction. Used with order_by (default asc).

page.description: Page number (default 1). Use last_page in the response to read further pages.
